rv.q: For all her painful childhood experiences, Annie is not a victim. Even Richard, the egotistical doctor who constantly undermines Hazel, has kind, even endearing, aspects in Huberman’s nuanced performance.

Prakash is an accomplished dancer who, at first at least, doesn’t give too much away. A contained presence, her movement is economical, undemonstrative, and not clouded by the strain of visible effort (there’s great skill in that, and power over her instrument).
